domain.easy: 2<=abs(A)<=12; abs(B)=1; 1<=C<=12. Unit y coefficient; integer slope.
domain.moderate: 2<=abs(A)<=12; 2<=abs(B)<=6; gcd(abs(A),abs(B))>1; reduced abs numerator<=6 and denominator<=3; 1<=C<=12. Divide and reduce familiar coefficients.
domain.hard: 5<=abs(A)<=12; 3<=abs(B)<=6; gcd(abs(A),abs(B))=1; 1<=C<=12. Primitive noninteger slope with larger numerator/denominator; same isolation method.
